I know this is really old so I apologize if it's bad form to comment on a 6 month old post. Research I've read indicates that exercise doesn't play too much of a role in childhood obesity but it does help them set up habits for later in life so it's still a good idea to encourage it. Still, as important as having them run around is, you really want to make sure you pay attention to what they eat. TV watching encourages mindless snacking and if they're watching TV you need to make sure it isn't accompanied by chips or sodas or juice or whatever.

If your kid is used to watching TV then breaking habits like that could be a pretty painful process and an uphill battle of wills but you have to remember that you are the parent. If your priority is your kid stops watching so much TV, set hard limits of no more than X hours of TV a day. Take the router/cablebox with you if you have to. To change habits you will have to be the bad guy for a while.

Consider that there are lots of options for physical activity and it doesn't all have to be what's commonly thought of as sports. She could take some sort of martial arts classes. There were a few girls in my son's jiu jitsu class and some of them were pretty tough and they looked like they had a lot of fun. You could go on bike rides in the evening together. Ten is still young enough that they look up to you a bit instead of pretty much exclusively being influenced by their friends and the media. So there's still some opportunity to lead by example. Does she see you being active and getting exercise regularly?

Maybe get some of those more active dance video games where you have to move around. I think in practice people will gravitate to the lazier games but if there's a way to enforce it like "it is either sports or this" then there might be a way to get her doing it. But speaking of dancing, you could sign her up for actual dance classes like hip hop dance or something. Not sure what's available in your area but there's usually pretty good stuff for kids.

Anyhow, I hope you see this at some point or came up with something that worked for you. If you ever wanted to do a followup update reply or something it would be nice to hear if you made any progress.
